decisions.reason: The proofreading instruction does not change which manuscript file or approved rewrites are authoritative for integration.
Checking the manuscript for double periods does not change the italics or quotation treatment required for Mama's Hot Take content.
The source does not identify or alter the dedication content or its required line and paragraph removals.
The manuscript-wide double-period check does not change any cover design, content, or responsibility decision.
The general double-period check does not modify Chapter 12's subtitle hierarchy, line treatment, or capitalization requirements.
The source does not specifically change the copyright page's attribution, alignment, email, or website content.
Text punctuation proofreading does not change the editorial criteria or selections used to assess chapter images.
The proofreading request does not change the requested publishing-readiness, copyright, or paperback guidance.
The double-period check does not alter the existing requirement to exclude the literal newline artifact from the title.
Punctuation proofreading does not change the decision to retain the current paragraph spacing and page density.
The source concerns manuscript punctuation and does not affect image aspect ratio, cropping, pixelation, or rendering artifacts.
